item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong positive evidence that Tshisekedi personally avoided manipulating electoral rules, courts, media, election commissions, security forces, or public resources. The best counterevidence is limited and procedural, not substantive: opposition seats still existed, and the election process moved through formal institutions. The overall pattern still points toward entrenchment pressure, especially because of the October 2024 term-limit push.","evidence":[{"title":"Congo’s election commission cancels 82 candidates in disputed December polling","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-07","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congos-election-commission-cancels-82-candidates-in-disputed-december-polling/1913556/","summary":"CENI canceled votes for 82 legislative candidates over alleged fraud and other problems; the government and election commission still defended the poll as fair.
